_comment: Trace Browser, Browser page (card T2). Drawn by emtk.view_form over TraceBrowserModel (gui/model.py); the trace plot (card T3) and the export / hand-off controls (card T4) are not part of this spec yet.
title: Trace browser

sections.description: Go back to the detector setup, open a folder of TTTR files, or clear what the browser holds.

buttons.label: ← Select setup
buttons.description: Go back to the detector setup page. The accepted setup, the folder and the file list stay as they are.

buttons.label: Open
buttons.description: Choose a folder with PTU/TTTR files. You can also drop a folder on the window.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Clear the file list, the selection and the shown trace. No file and no rating or note is changed.

buttons.label: Clear caches
buttons.description: Delete the cached traces and the cached image probes of this folder, in memory and on disk. Traces are computed again when needed.

sections.label: Folder
sections.description: The folder whose files are listed. Use Open, or drop a folder on the window.

sections.label: Include subfolders
sections.description: Also list the files in the sub-folders of the opened folder (the .trash folder is never listed). Switching it rescans the folder.

sections.label: Filter
sections.description: Show only the files whose rating passes: all, at least 1, 2 or 3 stars, or only unrated files.

sections.label: Bin window [ms]
sections.description: Width of the time bins of the intensity trace in milliseconds. The trace itself is drawn by a later card; the value is kept and remembered.
The y axis range of the trace plot.

sections.label: Y min
sections.description: Lower limit of the trace plot's y axis (counts per bin). Entered the wrong way round with Y max, the two are swapped.

sections.label: Y max
sections.description: Upper limit of the trace plot's y axis (counts per bin).
How many files were found in the folder and how many pass the filter, or what went wrong.

sections.title: Files
sections.description: One row per listed file. Click a row to select it; double click a rating or a note to edit it. Ratings and notes are saved beside the data in the folder's .trace_browser_meta.json.

columns.title: File
columns.description: File name, relative to the opened folder. Click the header to sort.

columns.title: Rating
columns.description: Rating from 0 (unrated) to 5. Double click, type a whole number and press Enter. Sorting by this column orders by the number.

columns.title: Notes
columns.description: Free text about the file. Double click, type and press Enter; it is saved with the rating.
